##### DATA PREPROCESSING FOR CARIES OUTCOME ######

```{r}
## Dataset splitting
library(rsample)

set.seed(123)

SB_split1 <- initial_split(
  SBBrazil_perio,
  prop = 0.80,
  strata = Periodontal_disease_status
)

P_trainset <- training(SB_split1)
P_testset  <- testing(SB_split1)
```

```{r}
### Data preprocessing using recipes package for caries

Perio_recipe <- recipe(Periodontal_disease_status ~ .,data = P_trainset) %>%
    role_case(stratum = Periodontal_disease_status) %>%
    step_rm(codigo,OHRQoL )%>%
    check_missing(Periodontal_disease_status) %>%
    step_filter_missing(all_predictors(),threshold = 0.50) %>%
    step_nzv(all_predictors()) %>%
    step_impute_knn(all_predictors())%>%
    step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors()) %>%
    step_corr(all_numeric_predictors(), threshold = 0.9) %>%
    step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())
    

##prep the recipe
    Perioprep <- prep(Perio_recipe, training = P_trainset)
    #Carieprep
##Bake the prepped recipes for both trainset and testset
    Perio_baked_train <- bake(Perioprep, new_data = P_trainset)
    Perio_baked_test  <- bake(Perioprep, new_data = P_testset)

Perio_baked_train
Perio_baked_test

```

####CROSSVALIDATION  AND TUNNING#####

```{r}
##cross validation
Control <- CVControl(folds = 5, seed = 123)
```

                ########################### LOGISTIC REGRESSION ##########################

```{r}
##Model tunning
set.seed(123)
MODEL<- TunedModel(GLMModel(family = binomial), control = Control)
```


```{r}
### Model fitting 
set.seed(123)

P_LOGFit <- fit(Periodontal_disease_status ~ .,data = Perio_baked_train, model = MODEL)

P_LOGres <- resample(Periodontal_disease_status ~ .,data = Perio_baked_train, model = MODEL, control = Control)

#summary(P_LOGFit)
#summary(P_LOGres)
```

##### LOGISTIC REGRESSION RESAMPLE  ######
```{r}
P_perf_res_log <- performance(
  P_LOGres,
  metrics = c(
    "ROC AUC"     = "roc_auc",
    "PR AUC"      = "pr_auc",
    "Brier Score" = "brier",
    "Accuracy"    = "accuracy",
    "Sensitivity" = "sensitivity",
    "Specificity" = "specificity",
    "PPV"         = "ppv",
    "NPV"         = "npv",
    "F1"          = "f_score"
  )
)

#summary(P_perf_res_log)
```

##### LOGISTIC REGRESSION PERFORMANCE ASSESSMENT ON TESTSET ######
```{r }
#### Evaluate on the untouched 50% test set

# Observed test outcomes
obs_test <- response(P_LOGFit,newdata = Perio_baked_test)

# Predicted probability of the second factor level,which should be the positive class
pred_test <- predict(P_LOGFit,newdata = Perio_baked_test,type = "prob")
#pred_test

# Predicted classes using the default cutoff of 0.50
class_test <- predict(P_LOGFit,newdata = Perio_baked_test,cutoff  = 0.50)
#class_test

# Test-set metrics
test_performance <- performance(obs_test,pred_test,
  metrics = c(
    "ROC AUC"     = "roc_auc",
    "PR AUC"      = "pr_auc",
    "Brier Score" = "brier",
    "Accuracy"    = "accuracy",
    "Sensitivity" = "sensitivity",
    "Specificity" = "specificity",
    "PPV"         = "ppv",
    "NPV"         = "npv",
    "F1"          = "f_score"
    ),
  cutoff = 0.50)

test_performance

# Test-set confusion matrix
table(Observed  = obs_test,Predicted = class_test)

```

```{r}
#install.packages("shapviz")
#install.packages("fastshap",repos = c("https://bgreenwell.r-universe.dev", "https://cloud.r-project.org"))


library(fastshap)
library(shapviz)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```


##Assign category
```{r}
levels(Perio_baked_train$Periodontal_disease_status)

positive_class <- "YES"
```


##Remove outcome variable from the trainset
```{r}
X_train_GB <- Perio_baked_train %>%
  select(-Periodontal_disease_status)

X_test_GB <- Perio_baked_test %>%
  select(-Periodontal_disease_status)
```

##create a wrapper for prediction
```{r}
pred_wrapper_GB <- function(object, newdata) {
  
  pred <- predict(
    object,
    newdata = newdata,
    type = "prob"
  )
  
  # If predict() returns a matrix/data frame of probabilities
  if (is.matrix(pred) || is.data.frame(pred)) {
    
    pred <- as.data.frame(pred)
    
    # Use YES column if it exists
    if ("YES" %in% names(pred)) {
      return(as.numeric(pred[["YES"]]))
    }
    
    # Otherwise use probability for second factor level
    return(as.numeric(pred[[2]]))
  }
  
  # If MachineShop already returns probability of second level
  return(as.numeric(pred))
}
```

##create a wrapper for the fitted model
```{r}
pred_wrapper_GB(
  P_GBFit,
  X_test_GB[1:10, , drop = FALSE]
)
```

##Create the SHAP framework using test performance of the best model
```{r}
set.seed(123)

n_shap <- min(1000, nrow(X_test_GB))

shap_index <- sample(
  seq_len(nrow(X_test_GB)),
  size = n_shap,
  replace = FALSE
)

X_explain_GB <- X_test_GB[
  shap_index,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
```

##Conduct the SHAP analysis --- explainable AI

```{r}
set.seed(123)

SHAP_GB <- fastshap::explain(
  object = P_GBFit,
  X = X_train_GB,
  newdata = X_explain_GB,
  pred_wrapper = pred_wrapper_GB,
  nsim = 200,
  adjust = TRUE
)
```


```{r}
SHAP_GB_matrix <- as.matrix(SHAP_GB)

SHAP_GB_viz <- shapviz(
  SHAP_GB_matrix,
  X = X_explain_GB
)
```

##Create a beeswarm plot for variable importance based on the SHAP value
```{r}
sv_importance(
  SHAP_GB_viz,
  kind = "beeswarm",
  max_display = 20
)
```

##Export and save the beeswarm plot 
```{r}
SHAP_beeswarm_GB <- sv_importance(
  SHAP_GB_viz,
  kind = "beeswarm",
  max_display = 20
)

ggsave(
  "GB_SHAP_Beeswarm.png",
  plot = SHAP_beeswarm_GB,
  width = 9,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 600
)
```

##Create a variable importance plot on a bar chart based on the SHAP value
```{r}
sv_importance(
  SHAP_GB_viz,
  kind = "bar",
  max_display = 20
)



##save it
SHAP_bar_GB <- sv_importance(
  SHAP_GB_viz,
  kind = "bar",
  max_display = 20
)

ggsave(
  "GB_SHAP_Global_Importance.png",
  plot = SHAP_bar_GB,
  width = 8,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 600
)
```



```{r}
SHAP_importance_GB <- data.frame(
  Variable = colnames(SHAP_GB_matrix),
  Mean_Absolute_SHAP = apply(
    abs(SHAP_GB_matrix),
    2,
    mean,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
) %>%
  arrange(desc(Mean_Absolute_SHAP))

SHAP_importance_GB
```
